notes.title: Patch 1.003
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]Feature:[/b] You can now rejoin a multiplayer match in case you lost the connection.
[*] [b]Feature:[/b] The player list now shows who has and hasn't already made their choice.
[*] [b]Bugfix:[/b] Fixed a bug that caused a multiplayer match to get stuck when a player lost connection.
[*] [b]Bugfix:[/b] Fixed an issue where the 10K points achievement could not be obtained.
[*] [b]Bugfix:[/b] Fixed a possible crash when multiple players reset their turn.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.002
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]Feature:[/b] Added game instructions via a new option that is availabe both in the title screen and ingame.
[*] [b]Improvement:[/b] Improved the end game statistics panel.
[*] [b]Bugfix:[/b] Fixed a bug that cause a tutorial hint to appear when another hint was already visible.
[*] [b]Bugfix:[/b] Fixed several translation issues.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.001
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]Improvement:[/b] Just like in multiplayer, AI opponents now have really cool random names in singleplayer, too
[*] [b]Bugfix:[/b] When clicking "Back to main menu" a new game started instead
[/list]
